title: Design System: Legate Roman Command Workspace

wordmark.purpose: Application identity beside the laurel standard.

motion.name: reduced-motion

motion.name: dragging
motion.purpose: Disable transitions throughout the app while resizing.

layout.compactBehavior: Hide branch chip and active count; reduce header padding/context spacing. Existing layout state controls drawer overlay and resizable sidebar.
layout.navigationState: Rail active state follows active tab and visibility in its assigned dock.

narrative.overview: A terminal-first workstation with permanent tool navigation, resizable projects, an inset terminal stage and a focused inspector. Roman identity is carried by the laurel standard, serif wordmark, campaign seal and antique gold details. Documentation is source-derived; no screenshot exists and rendered visual verification is pending.
keyCharacteristics: Gold identity and red default-theme actions

rules.name: Separate identity and action
rules.body: Gold marks Roman identity and selected tool details; the default brand red marks primary commands and count badges. Signal remains a separate feedback/focus role.

rules.name: Tonal workspace depth
rules.body: Use bg, inset, raised and one-pixel borders for workspace separation.

dos: Do preserve terminal space and labeled tool navigation.
Do preserve theme variables, keyboard focus and reduced motion.
donts: Don't obscure operational labels with decorative Roman vocabulary.
Don't claim visual approval without rendered verification.
